 # Standardize the spelling and formatting of the HospitalOwner column
 def standardize_hospital_owner(value):
     # Remove hyphens, underscores, spaces, and convert to lowercase
     value = re.sub(r'[_- ]+', ' ', value).lower()

     # Replace non-standard abbreviations with their standard counterparts
     value = value.replace('gov', 'government')
     value = value.replace('proprietary', 'private')
     value = value.replace('voluntary non-profit - private', 'non-profit - private')
     value = value.replace('voluntary non-profit - other', 'non-profit - other')
     value = value.replace('government - hospital district or authority', 'government - hospital district')

     return value
return value
